 India vs. New Zealand 1st Test, Day 1 Live Score & Updates
 Welcome to CricketNews.com's live coverage of the 1st Test between India and New Zealand at Basin Reserve in Wellington.
 Toss result: 
 India won the toss  and elected to bowl first.
 Pre-match:
 India and New Zealand are set to play the two-match Test series, starting with the first Test at the Basin Reserve ground in Wellington on Thursday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As Shubman Gill captains India, while Tom Latham leads New Zealand, this will be India's first Test series in New Zealand since the 2019-20 tour, when the hosts secured a 2-0 series sweep with convincing wins in Wellington and Christchurch.
 Star spinner Mitchell Santner will miss the series with a fractured right hand, a blow for the home side. India, at least, have Shubman Gill, whose 1,024 runs this cycle are more than anyone in the competition has scored.
